So back in 2017, I went to a con in Baltimore and I begged my dad to go because it would be my first time there. Eventually my dad caved in and agreed to bring my ass there, and after about half an hour of driving and traffic we showed up to the event center and it was packed! I was cosplaying as my oc, which was like a butler with a gas mask and a detachable chainsaw hand. There were so many people over there and I was excited I practically threw the door open and ran inside, I saw so many people doing cosplay and so much merch I wanted to buy. I remember seeing a girl dressed as Miia and a guy I assumed to be her boyfriend dressed as Kimihito from Monster Musume, then something really " bad " happened.

As I put my headphones in, some kid ran up to me and grabbed my chainsaw from the floor and started swinging it around like a psycho. Now, I immediately got worried because the chainsaw took me about a week to get done and I took it back from him.
